text: {"lessons":["My account value can move substantially even when I make no trades, so I should judge progress over time rather than react to one period.","I bought more of Stocks A, B and D in consecutive periods; I should check how concentrated that leaves my portfolio and keep risk aligned with my ten-year goal.","A small account gain after buying does not show whether those trades were wise; I should make future buys based on a deliberate plan, not on short-term price moves."]}
